action.rationale: Fresh 10D problem with a 100-evaluation budget and no incumbent; per principle 1 we should learn the landscape first. Allocating ~12% (12 evals) for probes on this cheap, deterministic objective will reveal modality/smoothness and seed warm starts for the right method.

Probes show a strong funnel signal (fdc_spearman=0.7762) and no boundary issues (n_coords_near_bound=0) in 10D with cheap, deterministic evaluations and large variation (log10_range=4.876), which suits CMA-ES. With 88 evals left, starting CMA-ES from the incumbent y=6798.38 should yield steady progress within one round.

Only 38 evaluations remain, so we should spend them on local refinement. Probes indicate a smooth, funnel-like landscape (FDC Spearman 0.7762), and CMA-ES still has sigma 1.979, suggesting broader exploration than ideal for the last stretch. Polishing from the incumbent (y=4592.27 at eval 61) is the best use of the remaining budget.
